description: NLP Prompt Compressor for LLMs. Reduces token usage by up to 70% using semantic contraction across 50+ languages. Licensed under the Caveman License (MIT + mandatory attribution to Passaro Francesco Paolo - Digitalsolutions.it). Bundled language data derived from Universal Dependencies (see NOTICE).
releaseNotes: 1.4.5: Synthelion 1.2.5 fixes ported. (1) Structured values (IPs, versions, dates, URLs, e-mails, grouped decimals, percentages) survive every compression level. (2) Chinese/Japanese output is no longer longer than the input. (3) Indentation-based languages (Python, Ruby, shell) are detected as code. (4) Comment stripping is string-aware: it never cuts inside a string literal. (5) Structured-content guard: JSON, code, SQL, HTML, diffs and tables are routed to their structure-aware compressors and YAML/config is returned unchanged instead of being corrupted by the word filters. 1.4.4: Synthelion 1.2.5 feature port. (1) Numeric tokens preserved across every compression level — Semantic/Aggressive/Statistical/Syntactic previously dropped ports, amounts, percentages, versions, dates and temperatures; numbers are now always retained verbatim (never lemmatised). (2) New global-IDF provider and tables: 56 per-language {iso3}.idf.br document-frequency tables (built from Wikipedia, shipped as embedded brotli like the other worddata — same tables as Synthelion 1.2.5, ~128 MB) blended 50/50 into the Statistical level's TF-IDF scoring so word importance is grounded in real-world rarity, and used by Aggressive to additionally drop words ubiquitous in >50% of the reference corpus. Languages without a table fall back to the exact 1.4.3 local-only behavior. (3) SQL-aware compression: new CavemanSqlCompressor — SQL is auto-detected (ContentType.Sql) and routed away from the NLP path into a lossless whitespace/formatting collapse that protects keywords, string/numeric literals, quoted identifiers and comments; optional VALUES-tuple folding (lossy, CCR-hashed) mirrors CavemanJsonCrusher's row-drop. All changes additive and backward-compatible. Includes full 1.4.2/1.4.3 history below: 1.4.3 was a corrective re-publish of 1.4.2 (previously the 1.4.2 NuGet package was packed from a stale snapshot missing 1.4.0/1.4.1 features), carrying the language-quality pass ported back from Synthelion 1.2.0, negation-particle protection (eng/ita/fra/spa/deu/por/zho), the Italian "subito" ADV-homograph lemma fix, CavemanCjkSegmenter (jieba-style dictionary Chinese segmentation), mojibake repair in worddata/zho* and 10 further languages, and language-detection data contamination fixes ("john"/"ha"/"e"/"ate").
